summary: Implemented the window title feature; nothing was run, all changes verified by reading only. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) ControlCode variant; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(title); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which returns True only when is_terminal; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32, using sys.platform because WINDOWS is not imported there), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions. No commit was made.
